summaries.name: Golden Artist Colors
summaries.summary: Golden Artist Colors is a highly respected acrylic paint brand known for high-quality, light-fast, vibrant paints, including their Heavy Body and Fluid Acrylic lines.

summaries.name: Liquitex
summaries.summary: Liquitex is a well-established acrylic paint brand offering Soft Body, Heavy Body, and Spray Paint lines, known for excellent pigmentation and durability.

summaries.name: Daler-Rowney
summaries.summary: Daler-Rowney is a British art supply company founded in 1783. Its System 3 Acrylic paint range offers good lightfastness and a wide color range; its System 3 Acrylic Brushes are designed specifically for use with acrylic paints, offering synthetic and natural fiber brushes in various sizes and shapes.

summaries.name: Winsor & Newton
summaries.summary: Winsor & Newton is a renowned art brand offering acrylic paints, including the Galeria and Artists' Acrylic lines, known for high-quality pigments and durability. Its Cotman and Artists' Acrylic brushes are popular among artists for good quality and affordability.

summaries.name: Loew-Cornell
summaries.summary: Loew-Cornell is a US-based company specializing in art brushes. Its Acrylic Brushes are known for durability and versatility, suitable for a variety of techniques.

summaries.name: Robert Simmons
summaries.summary: Robert Simmons is a well-respected art brush brand offering high-quality acrylic brushes, including its popular Signature and Express lines.
